exposure: maternal blood glucose patterns throughout pregnancy
maternal glucose trajectories (consistent normoglycemia, mid-to-late gestational hyperglycemia, early-onset hyperglycemia)
outcome: neonatal amino acids (alanine, arginine, ornithine, proline)
neonatal acylcarnitines (C4DC+C5-OH, C6DC, C10:1, free acylcarnitine)
cohort: The study included 11,457 singleton pregnant women without preexisting diabetes and their neonates born between July 2021 and October 2022.
finding: Maternal glucose trajectories throughout pregnancy, particularly mid-to-late gestational and early-onset hyperglycemia, were significantly associated with altered neonatal amino acid and acylcarnitine profiles, with some associations primarily observed in male neonates.
